name: Nagykónyi (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a red stripe at the hoist edge and a blue stripe at the fly edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagykónyi (a blue and red shield with a yellow charge, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name NAGYKÓNYI in grey.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagykónyi arms with helm, crest and mantling
